name: Regex symbol scanner for anchors
description: Find the enclosing declaration (class/record/method/function) for a line using language-agnostic regex heuristics. No native dependencies (no tree-sitter) so the tools stay pure managed.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged e5dc4d1. SymbolIndex.Scan(SourceText) with EnclosingAt/SymbolAt/Find; Anchor.CreateWithSymbol. Symbols are dot-joined containers without namespaces (Outer.Inner.Method; Go receiver methods are Type.Method; Rust impl methods are Type.method). Find falls back to the longest matching trailing segments, so moved containers still match, and returns all overloads. Covers C#, Java, TS/JS, Python (indentation), Go and Rust. Limits: no C# properties/operators, one declaration per line, scanner doesn't look at the file type (only scan source files by extension). For #21: tell overloads apart by hash or line distance; scan once per file instead of calling CreateWithSymbol repeatedly.
